svg.aria-label: The whole periodic table shaded in two greys: the palest grey, metals, fills the left side and the middle; a mid grey, nonmetals, fills the top right; a heavy zigzag staircase runs between them from boron down to tellurium, and six cells along it are left white; six dashed, hatched cells at the right of the bottom row are the untested elements 113 to 118; a legend names the two shades
svg.text: 57–71 and 89–103 are 30 more metals, usually printed in two extra rows; this drawing leaves them out.
dashed, hatched cells, 113–118: too little of these has been made to test
